_note: Workflow settings. Change these instead of rewriting the skill as models improve; the monthly sync may propose new values.
A repo can override any key in .bridge/config.json (gitignored).

execution: native = the main session builds slices itself (subagents for parallel slices, risky reviews and the final review); delegated = one implementer subagent per task (for huge changes or weaker models).
task_size: slice = 15-30 minute vertical slices; micro = 2-5 minute steps.
design: auto = design.md only for risky, large or cross-module changes, otherwise a short Approach section in proposal.md; always; never.
gates: combined = one approval for proposal, scenarios and approach; separate = approve proposal, then design.
brainstorm_rounds: maximum question rounds; 0 = when the request is clear, state assumptions instead of asking.
doc_caps: soft line limits; the guards warn when they are exceeded.
